# Scenario 4: Automated Port Stripping security mechanism
# Verifies that unauthorized host port mappings are stripped at merge time.

# Step 1: Initialize Git repo with insecure compose file
cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: insecure ports commit'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# Step 2: Run agent
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

# Step 3: Assert containers are running but sandboxed
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-db-postgres-1

# Step 4: Custom assert to ensure port 5432 was not exposed to the public host
docker-assert-no-public-ports apinfra_e2e-db-postgres-1


# --- FILE TEMPLATES ---

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-db
    enabled: true
    config: {} # allow-ports-mapping is missing (defaults to false)

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-db/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  postgres:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:5432", "-text=OK"]
    ports:
      - "5432:5432" # Insecure attempt to expose database to the world

-- .env --
